verdict.rationale: IVS emits stream events into Amazon EventBridge, where users can create rules that trigger on them. The evidence does not show IVS itself offering registrable outbound HTTP webhook callbacks. EventBridge is a host-platform routing service, so this is adjacent support only and earns no credit for a webhooks story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: You can use Amazon EventBridge to monitor your Amazon Interactive Video Service (IVS) streams.
You can create a rule that triggers on an event emitted by Amazon IVS.
